_doc: Bangalore OSM layers for scripts/fetch-osm-layers.ts. After a water-body re-fetch, re-run scripts/name-bangalore-water-bodies.py to restore the named-lake join (the envelope documents both steps).

water-bodies._note: Wider than the GBA 369-ward bbox: south past Anekal, north past Yelahanka to the Arkavathi headworks, west to TG Halli. Drains and wastewater are conveyance, not water bodies.

rivers._note: Extended past GBA to the Arkavati headwaters at Nandi Hills and the Vrishabhavathi's reach past Byramangala; clipped to the same box. OSM spells the rivers several ways, so each carries one canonical label.
Then Pennai and Ponnaiyar are its Tamil Nadu names.
rivers.label: Dakshina Pinakini
